title: capsella laxa
intro: Capsella laxa, commonly known as shepherd's purse, is a flowering plant in the mustard family (Brassicaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Capsella laxa include its use as an anticoagulant, to reduce bleeding and prevent blood clots, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents of Capsella laxa include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
